available.quote: The board shall issue a license to practice professional nursing or practical nursing without examination to an applicant who has been duly licensed or registered as a nurse under the laws of another state, territory, or country, if in the opinion of the board the applicant has the qualifications equivalent to the qualifications required in this state

requirements.quote: The board shall seek reciprocity of nurse licensure with Iowa, North Dakota, South Dakota, and Wisconsin.

national_certification.quote: must be currently certified by a national certifying body recognized by the board in the APRN role and population foci appropriate to educational preparation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to demonstrate the qualifications or satisfy the requirements for a license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to demonstrate the qualifications or satisfy the requirements for a license contained in sections 148.171 to 148.285 or rules of the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing fraud or deceit in procuring or attempting to procure a license, or subverting the licensing examination process.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Employing fraud or deceit in procuring or attempting to procure a permit, license, or registration certificate to practice advanced practice, professional, or practical nursing or attempting to subvert the licensing examination process.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony or gross misdemeanor reasonably related to the practice of nursing.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony or gross misdemeanor reasonably related to the practice of professional, advanced practice registered, or practical nursing.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Revocation, suspension, limitation, or other disciplinary action against the person's nursing license in another state, territory, or country.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Revocation, suspension, limitation, conditioning, or other disciplinary action against the person's professional or practical nursing license or advanced practice registered nursing credential, in another state, territory, or country

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure or inability to perform nursing with reasonable skill and safety.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to or inability to perform professional or practical nursing as defined in section 148.171, subdivision 14 or 15, with reasonable skill and safety

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in unprofessional conduct or departure from minimal standards of acceptable and prevailing nursing practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in unprofessional conduct, including, but not limited to, a departure from or failure to conform to board rules of professional or practical nursing practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure of an APRN to practice with reasonable skill and safety or departure from standards of acceptable APRN nursing.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure of an advanced practice registered nurse to practice with reasonable skill and safety or departure from or failure to conform to standards of acceptable and prevailing advanced practice registered nursing.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Delegating or accepting delegation of a nursing function when the delegation could reasonably be expected to result in unsafe patient care.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Delegating or accepting the delegation of a nursing function or a prescribed health care function when the delegation or acceptance could reasonably be expected to result in unsafe or ineffective patient care.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Actual or potential inability to practice nursing safely due to illness, alcohol, drug, chemical, or mental/physical condition.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Actual or potential inability to practice nursing with reasonable skill and safety to patients by reason of illness, use of alcohol, drugs, chemicals, or any other material, or as a result of any mental or physical condition.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Adjudication as mentally incompetent, mentally ill, chemically dependent, or a person dangerous to the public.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Adjudication as mentally incompetent, mentally ill, a chemically dependent person, or a person dangerous to the public by a court of competent jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in unethical conduct likely to deceive, defraud, or harm the public.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in any unethical conduct, including, but not limited to, conduct likely to deceive, defraud, or harm the public, or demonstrating a willful or careless disregard for the health, welfare, or safety of a patient.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in sexual conduct with or sexually demeaning behavior toward a patient.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in conduct with a patient that is sexual or may reasonably be interpreted by the patient as sexual, or in any verbal behavior that is seductive or sexually demeaning to a patient, or engaging in sexual exploitation of a patient or former patient.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining money, property, or services from a patient through undue influence, harassment, duress, deception, or fraud.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining money, property, or services from a patient, other than reasonable fees for services provided to the patient, through the use of undue influence, harassment, duress, deception, or fraud.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Revealing a privileged communication from or relating to a patient except when required or permitted by law.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Revealing a privileged communication from or relating to a patient except when otherwise required or permitted by law.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in abusive or fraudulent billing practices, including violations of Medicare, Medicaid, or state medical assistance laws.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in abusive or fraudulent billing practices, including violations of federal Medicare and Medicaid laws or state medical assistance laws.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Improper management of patient records, including failure to maintain adequate records.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Improper management of patient records, including failure to maintain adequate patient records, to comply with a patient's request made pursuant to sections 144.291 to 144.298, or to furnish a patient record or report required by law.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly aiding or assisting an unlicensed person to engage in the unlawful practice of nursing.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly aiding, assisting, advising, or allowing an unlicensed person to engage in the unlawful practice of advanced practice, professional, or practical nursing.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating a board rule, board order, or state/federal law relating to the practice of nursing or narcotics/controlled substances.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating a rule adopted by the board, an order of the board, or a state or federal law relating to the practice of advanced practice, professional, or practical nursing, or a state or federal narcotics or controlled substance law.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly providing false or misleading information directly related to patient care (except accepted therapeutic uses).
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly providing false or misleading information that is directly related to the care of that patient unless done for an accepted therapeutic purpose such as the administration of a placebo.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding suicide or aiding attempted suicide in violation of section 609.215.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding suicide or aiding attempted suicide in violation of section 609.215

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing outside the authorized scope of practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing outside the scope of practice authorized by section 148.171, subdivision 5, 10, 11, 13, 14, 15, or 21.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making a false statement or providing false information to the board, failing to make required reports, or failing to cooperate with board investigations.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making a false statement or knowingly providing false information to the board, failing to make reports as required by section 148.263, or failing to cooperate with an investigation of the board as required by section 148.265.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in false, fraudulent, deceptive, or misleading advertising.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in false, fraudulent, deceptive, or misleading advertising.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to inform the board of the nurse's APRN certification or recertification status.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to inform the board of the person's certification or recertification status as a certified registered nurse anesthetist, certified nurse-midwife, certified nurse practitioner, or certified clinical nurse specialist.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in APRN practice without a license and current national certification.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in clinical nurse specialist practice, nurse-midwife practice, nurse practitioner practice, or registered nurse anesthetist practice without a license and current certification or recertification by a national nurse certification organization acceptable to the board.

definition_quote.value: The 'practice of professional nursing' means the performance, with or without compensation, of those services that incorporates caring for all patients in all settings through nursing standards recognized by the board
definition_quote.quote: The "practice of professional nursing" means the performance, with or without compensation, of those services that incorporates caring for all patients in all settings through nursing standards recognized by the board

value: teaching theory and practice of nursing
methods_authorized.quote: providing a comprehensive assessment of the health status of a patient through the collection, analysis, and synthesis of data used to establish a health status baseline and plan of care

drug_authority.value: APRNs are authorized to prescribe, procure, sign for, record, administer, and dispense over-the-counter, legend, and controlled substances, including sample drugs. RNs may implement protocols resulting in prescriptions of legend drugs delegated by a licensed practitioner.
drug_authority.quote: prescribe, procure, sign for, record, administer, and dispense over-the-counter, legend, and controlled substances, including sample drugs

lpn_supervision_requirements.quote: the performance, with or without compensation, of those services that incorporates caring for individual patients in all settings through nursing standards recognized by the board at the direction of a registered nurse, advanced practice registered nurse, or other licensed health care provider

prescriptive_authority_certificate_requi.quote: Advanced practice registered nurses are authorized to: (1) diagnose, prescribe, and institute therapy or referrals of patients to health care agencies and providers; (2) prescribe, procure, sign for, record, administer, and dispense over-the-counter, legend, and controlled substances, including sample drugs

value: controlled substances (all schedules, subject to DEA compliance)
controlled_substance_schedule_authority.quote: prescribe, procure, sign for, record, administer, and dispense over-the-counter, legend, and controlled substances, including sample drugs

dea_registration_required.quote: Advanced practice registered nurses must: (1) comply with federal Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA) requirements related to controlled substances; and (2) file any and all of the nurse's DEA registrations and numbers with the board.

delegation_to_unlicensed_personnel_autho.quote: "Delegation" means the transfer of authority to another nurse or competent, unlicensed assistive person to perform a specific nursing task or activity in a specific situation.

employer_mandatory_reporting_required.quote: An employer of a person regulated by a health-related licensing board, and a health care institution or other organization where the regulated person is engaged in providing services, must report to the appropriate licensing board that a regulated person has diverted narcotics or other controlled substances in violation of state or federal narcotics or controlled substance law

multistate_license_option_available.quote: A license to practice professional or practical nursing issued by Iowa, North Dakota, South Dakota, or Wisconsin (border state) to a resident in that state must be recognized by the board as authorizing a licensure privilege to practice professional or practical nursing in Minnesota

impaired_nurse_alternative_program_avail.quote: A health-related licensing board may establish performance criteria and contract for a diversion program for regulated professionals who are unable to practice with reasonable skill and safety by reason of illness, use of alcohol, drugs, chemicals, or any other materials, or as a result of any mental, physical, or psychological condition.

public_health_nurse_certification_availa.quote: "Public health nurse" means a registered nurse who meets the voluntary registration requirements established by the board by rule.

nurse_practitioner_transition_to_practic.quote: must practice for at least 2,080 hours, within the context of a collaborative agreement, within a hospital or integrated clinical setting where advanced practice registered nurses and physicians work together to provide patient care

crna_physician_supervision_model.quote: A registered nurse anesthetist may perform nonsurgical therapies for acute and chronic pain symptoms upon referral and in collaboration with a physician licensed under chapter 147.
